i1.title: Arabiyat Prestige Sugar Coconut Chiffon Eau de Parfum 100ml

  • Base: Vanilla, Butter, Sugar, Musk

  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Gourmand · Oriental · Vanilla

i9.title: Ted Baker Fusion Cosmic Crush Body & Hair Mist 200ml
i9.descriptionHtml:
A fruity, floral spritz for body and hair.

Ted Baker Fusion Cosmic Crush Body & Hair Mist 200ml is a fruity-floral mist with warm woody notes. Pink pepper, melon and coconut open playfully, a heart of vanilla, orchid and orange flower follows, and it settles on amber, musk and sandalwood. Glycerin and pro-vitamin B5 leave skin feeling moisturised.

Scent

  • Top: Pink Pepper, Melon, Coconut
  • Heart: Vanilla, Orchid, Orange Flower
  • Base: Amber, Musk, Sandalwood

Key ingredients

  • Glycerin for scented hydration
  • Pro-vitamin B5 (panthenol)

How to use

  • Hold about 15cm from body and hair and spritz lightly
  • Reapply through the day as you like
  • Avoid the eyes

Good to know

  • Vegan friendly
  • Flammable: keep away from heat

Key details

  • Brand: Ted Baker
  • Range: Fusion
  • Type: Body & hair mist
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Woody
  • Size: 200ml

Why you'll love it

  • Fruity-floral scent with a warm base
  • Use on body and hair
  • With glycerin and pro-vitamin B5
  • Vegan friendly

FAQ

What does it smell like?

Pink pepper, melon and coconut with vanilla and orchid over amber, musk and sandalwood.

Can I use it on my hair?

Yes, spritz lightly over body and hair from about 15cm.
